name: Abyss Bug
description:
This Shine Bug emits no Light, but it makes up for it by having an excellent personality.

Their eggs contain small amounts of Resin that can be harvested when cracked at the Egg Cracker.

name: Azure Bug
description:
Azure Bugs emit a soft blue Light when Happy, in hopes of attracting more of their kind for company.

Their eggs contain small amounts of Resin that can be harvested when cracked at the Egg Cracker.

name: Bammoth
description:
Bammoths are lumbering, nonhostile creatures that subsist on Plume Squash, Nosh Beans and Squash Fries.

Their thick overcoats can be shorn for Reed Fiber used in Clothing production.

name: Beakon
description:
Beakons are aquatic critters who feast on Phosphorite and Starnacle, and excrete Lime.

They produce Light when Happy, and enjoy consuming Oxygen.

name: Beeta
description:
Beetas are hostile critters that thrive in Radioactive environments.

They commonly gather Uranium Ore for their Beeta Hives to produce Enriched Uranium.

name: Beeta Hive
description:
A moderately Radioactive nest made by Beetas.

Converts Uranium Ore into Enriched Uranium when worked by a Beeta.
Will not function if ground below has been destroyed.

name: Biobot
description:
A Pathogen-Fueled Extravehicular Geo-Exploratory Guidebot (model Y), aka "P.E.G.G.Y."

It can be assigned basic building tasks and digging duties in hazardous environments.

name: Blowter
description: Blowters are aquatic critters who produce Oxygen after eating leaves from Waterweed plants.

name: Blum Lumb
description:
Blum Lumbs are non-hostile critters that produce Algae.

When they stomp heavily near plants, the commotion causes harvestable items to fall to the ground.

name: Coral Bug
description:
Coral Bugs emit a soft pink Light when Happy, in hopes of attracting more of their kind for company.

Their eggs contain small amounts of Resin that can be harvested when cracked at the Egg Cracker.

name: Cuddle Pip
description:
Cuddle Pips are affectionate critters who are known to cuddle eggs, increasing their incubation rate.

This instinct is amplified when these critters are hugged by a passing Duplicant.

name: Dartle
description:
Dartles are non-hostile critters who eat Dewdrips and excrete Bleach Stone and Chlorine Gas.

They are preyed on by Rhexes.

name: Delecta Vole
description:
Delecta Voles are burrowing critters whose bodies sprout shearable Tonic Root when Regolith is ingested at preferred temperatures.

They cannot burrow through Refined Metals.

name: Dense Puft
description: Dense Pufts are non-aggressive critters that excrete condensed Oxylite with each breath.

name: Drecko
description:
Dreckos are nonhostile critters that graze on Pincha Pepperplants, Balm Lily or Mealwood Plants.

Their backsides are covered in thick woolly fibers that only grow in Hydrogen climates.

name: Flox
description:
Floxes are nonhostile critters that graze on Bristle Blossoms and Pikeapples.

When Flox antlers are fully grown, they harden into shearable Wood.

name: Flydo
description:
A programmable delivery robot.

Picks up Solid objects for delivery to selected destinations.

name: Gassy Moo
description:
Moos are extraterrestrial critters that feed on Gas Grass and excrete Natural Gas.

When domesticated and fed, they can be milked for Brackene.

name: Gildgo
description:
Gildgos are nonhostile critters that consume Sulfur and excrete Obsidian.

The shells they leave behind after molting can be crushed into Gold Amalgam.

They also leave large amounts of Mucin in their wake.

name: Glo Squid
description:
Glo Squids are nonhostile critters unless their eggs are nearby.

They eat Tublia and excrete Abyssalite .

They can be milked for Squid Ink.

name: Glossy Drecko
description:
Glossy Dreckos are nonhostile critters that graze on live Mealwood Plants and Bristle Blossoms.

Their backsides are covered in bioplastic scales that only grow in Hydrogen Gas climates.

name: Gnit
description:
Gnits are hostile airborne critters primarily bred as food for the carnivorous Lura Plants to produce Amber.

Their offspring must be exposed to Liquid in order to survive.

name: Grubgrub
description:
Grubgrubs form symbiotic relationships with plants, especially Grubfruit Plants, and instinctually tend to them.

Grubgrubs are closely related to Sweetles.

name: Gulp Fish
description:
Gulp Fishes are aquatic critters who inhabit cold liquid pools.

Their gills filter Polluted Water into Water.

name: Hatch
description: Hatches excrete solid Coal as waste and may be uncovered by digging up Buried Objects.

name: Husky Moo
description:
Husky Moos are extraterrestrial critters that feed on Plant Husk and Gas Grass, and excrete Carbon Dioxide.

When domesticated and fed, they can be milked for Biodiesel.

name: Jawbo
description:
Jawbos are carnivorous aquatic critters that feed on Pacus and produce Rust.

They pose no danger to Duplicants.

name: Kelpole
description:
Kelpoles are non-hostile aquatic critters that spawn along Tower Kelp stalks.

They can be harvested for Nori.

name: Longhair Slickster
description:
Longhair Slicksters are friendly critters that consume Oxygen and thrive in close contact with Duplicant companions.

Longhairs have extremely beautiful and luxurious coats.

name: Lumb
description:
Lumbs are non-hostile critters that subsist on Ovagro vines and excrete Peat.

When they stomp heavily near plants, the commotion causes harvestable items to fall to the ground.

name: Merpip
description:
Merpips are nonhostile aquatic critters that subsist on Caviar and Critter Molt.

They are known to bury aquatic plant Seeds in Liquid environments whenever they can find a suitable area with enough space.

name: Mimika
description:
Mimikas are airborne organisms that help nearby Plants grow more quickly.

When its leaves dry up, it will harden into Mimillet.

name: Molten Slickster
description: Molten Slicksters are slimy critters that consume Carbon Dioxide and exude Petroleum.

name: Morb
description: Morbs are attracted to unhygienic conditions and frequently excrete bursts of Polluted Oxygen.

name: Oakshell
description:
Oakshells are nonhostile critters unless their eggs are nearby.

They eat Polluted Dirt, Slime and Rot Piles.

The shells they leave behind after molting can be crushed into Wood.

Oakshells thrive in Ethanol.

name: Orehull
description:
Orehulls are shy aquatic critters that eat Kelpoles and excrete Polluted Mud.

They can be sheared for Iron Ore.

name: Pacu
description:
Pacus are aquatic creatures that can live in any liquid, such as Water or Polluted Water.

Every organism in the known universe finds the Pacu extremely delicious.

name: Pip
description:
Pips are pesky, nonhostile critters that subsist on Thimble Reeds and Arbor Tree branches.

They are known to bury Seeds in the ground whenever they can find a suitable area with enough space.

name: Plug Slug
description:
Plug Slugs are dynamic creatures that generate electrical Power during the night.

Their power can be harnessed by leaving an exposed wire near areas where they like to sleep.

name: Pokeshell
description:
Pokeshells are nonhostile critters unless their eggs are nearby.

They eat Polluted Dirt and Rot Piles.

The shells they leave behind after molting can be crushed into Lime.

name: Puft
description: Pufts are non-aggressive critters that excrete lumps of Slime with each breath.

name: Puft Prince
description: The Puft Prince is a lazy critter that excretes little Solid lumps of whatever it has been breathing.

name: Radiant Bug
description:
Radiant Bugs emit an extra-bright Light when Happy, in hopes of attracting more of their kind for company.

Their eggs contain small amounts of Resin that can be harvested when cracked at the Egg Cracker.

name: Regal Bammoth
description:
Regal Bammoths are nonhostile creatures that subsist on Plume Squash and Nosh Beans.

Their ornate crests grow only when they are fed Squash Fries.

name: Rhex
description:
Rhexes are carnivorous critters that feed on smaller Critters and produce Brine Ice.

Their tailfeathers can be shorn for Feather Fiber used in Clothing production.

name: Rover
description: A curious bot that can remotely explore new Planetoid locations.

name: Royal Bug
description:
Royal Bugs emit a soft purple Light when Happy, in hopes of attracting more of their kind for company.

Their eggs contain small amounts of Resin that can be harvested when cracked at the Egg Cracker.

name: Sage Hatch
description: Sage Hatches excrete solid Coal as waste and enjoy burrowing into the ground.

name: Sanishell
description:
Sanishells are nonhostile critters unless their eggs are nearby.

They thrive in Water and eliminate Germs from any liquid they inhabit.

They eat Polluted Dirt, Slime and Rot Piles.

name: Seaquine
description:
Seaquines are aquatic critters that live in liquid pools.

They feed on Pearl and produce Ovolene at the Aquatic Milking Station when Happy.

name: Shatter Flox
description:
Shatter Floxes are nonhostile critters that can subsist on Bristle Blossom and Pikeapple Bush.

Their shearable Glass antlers grow only when they are fed Abyssalite.

name: Shine Bug
description:
Shine Bugs emit a soft Light when Happy, in hopes of attracting more of their kind for company.

Their eggs contain small amounts of Resin that can be harvested when cracked at the Egg Cracker.

name: Shove Vole
description:
Shove Voles are burrowing critters that eat the Regolith collected on terrestrial surfaces.

They cannot burrow through Refined Metals.

name: Slickster
description: Slicksters are slimy critters that consume Carbon Dioxide and exude Crude Oil.

name: Slogo
description:
Slogos are nonhostile critters that consume Salt and excrete Dirt.

The shells they leave behind after molting can be crushed into Lime.

They also leave large amounts of Mucin in their wake.

name: Smog Slug
description:
Smog Slugs are porous creatures that draw in unbreathable Gases during the day.

At night, they sleep near exposed Gas Pipes, where they deposit their cache.

name: Smooth Hatch
description: Smooth Hatches enjoy burrowing into the ground and excrete Refined Metal when fed Metal Ore.

name: Spigot Seal
description:
Spigot Seals are charismatic creatures who produce Ethanol.

They eat Sucrose, and drink Nectar straight from the Bonbon Tree.

name: Sponge Slug
description:
Sponge Slugs are thirsty creatures that soak up Liquids during the day.

They deposit their stored Liquids into the exposed Liquid Pipes they sleep next to at night.

name: Squeaky Puft
description: Squeaky Pufts are non-aggressive critters that excrete lumps of Bleach Stone with each breath.

name: Stone Hatch
description: Stone Hatches excrete solid Coal as waste and enjoy burrowing into the ground.

name: Sun Bug
description:
Sun Bugs emit a soft orange Light when Happy, in hopes of attracting more of their kind for company.

Their eggs contain small amounts of Resin that can be harvested when cracked at the Egg Cracker.

name: Sweepy
description:
An automated sweeping robot.

Sweeps up Solid debris and Liquid spills and stores the material back in its Sweepy Dock.

name: Sweetle
description:
Sweetles are nonhostile critters that excrete large amounts of Sucrose.

They are closely related to the Grubgrub and exhibit similar, albeit less effective farming behaviors.

name: Tropical Pacu
description:
Tropical Pacus are aquatic critters who inhabit warm liquid pools.

Their vibrant colors provide a significant Decor boost to their environment.
